newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends down, drops 0.51 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends down, drops 0.51 pct in Feb.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0511 per dollar, down 0.03 percent in the day and 0.51 percent in the month, on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.

Shortly after the trading session opened, the Central Bank set a new weaker reais-dollar mini-band of between 1.0510 and 1.0560 reais per dollar. The mini-band was lowered 0.57 during February, almost the same 0.58 percent of decline in January.
The previous mini-band was set on Tuesday between 1.0505 and 1.0555 reais per dollar.
Dealers expect a calm market early next week.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0564 to the dollar, up 0.05 percent in the day, but down 0.57 percent in the month.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended at 1.098 per dollar, up 0.63 percent for the day but down 1.2 percent for the month.
